ModMetaData.name: [JDS] StarWars - The Separatist Droid Army
ModMetaData.author: JangoD'soul, Criz
ModMetaData.description:
[img]https://imgur.com/1zA4Gvl.png[/img] This mod adds the StarWars CIS faction and its droids.This mod adds a CIS scenario start (WIP) and a StarWar CIS Faction (hidden always hostile)
B1 Battle/Security droids Haul and Shoot. T1 Tactical droids can Craft, Smith, Tailor and Cook. Super tactical droid can Craft, Smith, Tailor, Cook and Reserch. Pistoeka droids can Mine and Build
IF "The Dead Man's Switch" mod is enabled "B1 Commander Droid" will be a "mech relay commander" like the DMS Sergeant.
